tasks.title: Verify kernel.self() legality inside a Compact constructor
tasks.description: Pure verification task — no production code is written. Use /midnight-verify:verify (or an equivalent minimal spike-compile via `compact compile --skip-zk` of a throwaway, uncommitted test contract) to determine whether `kernel.self()` and `tokenType(domainSep, kernel.self())` are legal and functional when called inside a Compact `constructor(...)`. This is the highest-priority open question in 2-technical/spec.md ADR-003: a prior PoC in this project already confirmed `mintShieldedToken()` works inside a constructor, but that PoC used a domain separator computed WITHOUT `kernel.self()` — the specific `kernel.self()` call inside a constructor remains untested. Write a minimal spike `.compact` contract (not placed under `contracts/`, not committed) whose constructor calls `kernel.self()` and `tokenType(...)`, compile it with `compact compile --skip-zk`, and if possible execute it via `@midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime` to confirm a real token-color value is produced (not just a type-check pass). Record the exact command, output, and PASS/FAIL verdict in 2-technical/spec.md under ADR-003 as a 'Verification Result' addendum.
acceptance_criteria: A minimal spike Compact contract with `kernel.self()` called inside a `constructor` is compiled via `compact compile --skip-zk` (or verified via /midnight-verify:verify), and the exact command plus its exit code/output are captured.

The verification verdict (PASS: kernel.self() is legal and functional in a constructor, or FAIL: the fallback applies) is appended to 2-technical/spec.md under ADR-003 as a 'Verification Result' note.

If the verdict is FAIL, the documented note explicitly states that Task 2 must implement the fallback instead (move `admin_token_color = tokenType(adminDomainSep(), kernel.self())` out of the constructor into a separate internal circuit invoked on the first post-deploy admin-gated call), and Task 2's description/acceptance criteria must be treated as amended accordingly before implementation begins.
No file under contracts/, src/, or scripts/ is created or modified by this task.
tasks.notes: CONFIRMADO: kernel.self() y tokenType(domainSep, kernel.self()) son legales y funcionales dentro de un constructor. Spike compilado (compact compile --skip-zk, compiler v0.31.1, exit 0) y ejecutado via @midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime: admin_token_color calculado en el constructor coincide byte-a-byte con el color del output Zswap real minteado en la misma llamada (cfb3b670a3eb4a54fe3f718fa3fa745ca2e1913ef78da3f0adbfc24bfb135d9a, value 2n). Ver 2-technical/spec.md ADR-003 'Verification Result'. Fallback NO requerido; Task 2 procede con el diseño happy-path sin modificaciones. Archivos temporales del spike eliminados post-verificación.

tasks.title: Add admin_token_color, consumeAdminToken(), and genesis mint in constructor
tasks.description: In contracts/did_registry.compact.template: add new ledger field `admin_token_color: Bytes<32>`; add new pure circuit `adminDomainSep(): Bytes<32>` returning `pad(32, "didmn:admin-token:v1")`; add new internal (non-exported) circuit `consumeAdminToken(coin: ShieldedCoinInfo): []` per ADR-001 — a structural near-clone of the existing `consumeToken()` that asserts `disclose(coin.color) == admin_token_color` (exact equality) instead of `valid_colors` membership, and shares the existing `used_capability_nullifiers` map (no separate nullifier map); change the constructor signature to `constructor(salt: Bytes<32>, admin_recipient: ZswapCoinPublicKey, admin_coin_nonce: Bytes<32>, admin_supply: Uint<64>)` per ADR-003, atomically minting `admin_supply + 1` admin-colored units directly to `admin_recipient` via `mintShieldedToken()`, setting `admin_token_color = tokenType(adminDomainSep(), kernel.self())`, and retaining the existing `role_by_key`/`admin_registered`/`initial_admin` writes as a read-model-only signal for `deriveRegistryAccess()` (not an authorization source); delete the `register_initial_admin()` exported circuit entirely — no post-deploy bootstrap step remains. If Task 1's verification found `kernel.self()` illegal in a constructor, apply the documented fallback (compute `admin_token_color` in a separate internal circuit invoked on the first post-deploy admin-gated call) instead of the happy-path implementation described above.
acceptance_criteria: contracts/did_registry.compact.template compiles without errors via `compact compile` after these changes.
The generated contract exposes `admin_token_color: Bytes<32>` as a ledger field and no longer exposes an exported `register_initial_admin` circuit.
`consumeAdminToken()` exists as a non-exported circuit that asserts exact equality against `admin_token_color` and reads/writes `used_capability_nullifiers`.

The constructor, invoked with `(salt, admin_recipient, admin_coin_nonce, admin_supply)`, mints `admin_supply + 1` admin-colored units directly to `admin_recipient` within the same transaction as deployment, with no separate bootstrap circuit call required.
tasks.notes: contracts/did_registry.compact.template modificado: ledger admin_token_color agregado; pure circuit adminDomainSep() agregado; circuit consumeAdminToken(coin) agregado (near-clone de consumeToken, comparte used_capability_nullifiers); constructor cambia a (salt, admin_recipient, admin_coin_nonce, admin_supply) y mintea admin_supply+1 unidades atómicamente vía mintShieldedToken; register_initial_admin() eliminado. compact compile --skip-zk exit 0. Verificado en el .d.ts generado.

tasks.title: Add rotate_admin_tokens circuit for atomic admin token replacement
tasks.description: In contracts/did_registry.compact.template, add the exported circuit `rotate_admin_tokens(coin: ShieldedCoinInfo, new_recipient: ZswapCoinPublicKey, new_coin_nonce: Bytes<32>): []` per ADR-003: assert the presented coin's color equals `admin_token_color` and its value is sufficient, assert its nullifier is unused in `used_capability_nullifiers`, burn it via `receiveShielded` + nullifier insert, then mint a fresh 2-unit admin coin to `new_recipient` via `mintShieldedToken` — all within the single circuit body so the burn and the mint execute as one atomic unit of the transaction (REQ-04), with no code path that commits the burn without also committing the mint.
acceptance_criteria: contracts/did_registry.compact.template compiles without errors via `compact compile` after adding rotate_admin_tokens.
rotate_admin_tokens asserts the presented coin's color equals admin_token_color and rejects an already-used nullifier before performing the burn.

The burn (receiveShielded + used_capability_nullifiers insert) and the mint (mintShieldedToken of a fresh 2-unit admin coin to new_recipient) both occur within the single rotate_admin_tokens circuit body.
tasks.notes: contracts/did_registry.compact.template modificado: export circuit rotate_admin_tokens(coin, new_recipient, new_coin_nonce) agregado — assert color==admin_token_color, assert value>=1, assert nullifier no usado, burn (receiveShielded + insert nullifier) y mint (mintShieldedToken 2 unidades) en el mismo cuerpo de circuit. compact compile --skip-zk exit 0. Verificado en el .d.ts generado (presente en ImpureCircuits/PureCircuits/Circuits con la firma esperada).

tasks.title: Add DID-linked color assert to request_update_did
tasks.description: In contracts/did_registry.compact.template, per ADR-005, insert one assert immediately after the existing did_controller/party_status preconditions and immediately before consumeToken(coin) in request_update_did: `assert(disclose(coin.color) == did_token_color.lookup(did_key), "Token does not match this DID")`. mintTokens and issueDid pass an admin coin obtained from _buildAdminCoin() as the first argument to their respective contract.callTx calls.

NOTA sobre la firma de rotateAdminTokens: la invocación del orquestador para esta task mencionó `opts: { newRecipientBytes; newSupply: bigint }`, pero tasks.json/2-technical/spec.md (Component Design, sección Client) especifican explícitamente `opts: { newRecipientBytes: Uint8Array }` sin newSupply, y el circuit rotate_admin_tokens del .d.ts generado confirma solo 3 parámetros (coin, new_recipient, new_coin_nonce) — no acepta supply; ADR-002 documenta que rotate_admin_tokens siempre mintea exactamente 2 unidades (1 anchor + 1 credit) por diseño, no un batch configurable. Se implementó la firma sin newSupply per tasks.json/spec (fuente de verdad), documentando la discrepancia aquí en vez de agregar un parámetro no usado que además rompería la compilación (tsconfig tiene noUnusedParameters:true). gatedSelfRegisterDid/requestUpdateDid/updateDid quedaron intencionalmente SIN cambios (siguen usando _buildCoin()) — no son admin-gated, consumen capability tokens vía consumeToken(), consistente con ADR-005. Verificación: `npx tsc --noEmit` → exit 0, 0 errores (incluyendo la resolución del TS6133 previo de Task 7). `npm test` (suite completa, 32 archivos) → 265 passed, 6 failed — los 6 fallos son 100% en tests/unified-registry.test.ts y corresponden exactamente a los tests desactualizados que Tasks 9/10 deben reescribir (1 test llama a api.registerInitialAdmin(), que ya no existe desde Task 7; 5 tests mockean estado de ledger sin admin_token_color, causando que _buildAdminCoin() falle al leer `ledger.admin_token_color` — mock desactualizado, no bug real). Los otros 31 archivos de test (265 tests) pasan sin cambios, confirmando que el wiring de Task 8 no rompió nada fuera del alcance esperado de tasks 9/10.

tasks.notes: tests/unified-registry.test.ts reescrito. Descubrimiento clave durante TDD: receiveShielded()+sendImmediateShielded() (usados por consumeToken/consumeAdminToken/rotate_admin_tokens) producen Zswap outputs adicionales de custodia/residuo propiedad del CONTRATO (recipient.is_left===false), intercalados con el output realmente gastable por el caller (recipient.is_left===true) — confirmado empíricamente corriendo el contrato compilado y volcando outputs[].recipient.is_left.
